Use case: precise-object-edit.
Image 1 is THE EXACT APPROVED MASTER, not a loose reference. The user says DO NOT DEVIATE FROM THIS LOOK. Make a carefully localized edit of this exact screenshot. Preserve the colors, saturation, exposure, SOFT subtle matte paper texture, restrained shadows, character faces, furniture construction, neighborhood and existing scene details almost pixel-for-pixel. DO NOT invent a new look. In particular do not add heavy wrinkles or embossed crumpled-paper overlays, do not turn the orange/yellow brighter, do not make the green more saturated, do not make faces more doll-like. Keep the SAME gentle tactile felt/cut-paper illustration of Image 1.
Needed changes are functional layout changes ONLY:
A. Adapt the office to SIX seated people: FOUR worker desks connected in a compact 2x2 island + ONE boss desk separate on the LEFT + ONE secretary reception counter near the entrance at lower-right/center. Preserve the existing four workers' EXACT identities, round faces, hairstyles, clothes and proportions. The rear two workers face the viewer behind their monitors (monitor backs visible); front two have backs to viewer (monitor screens visible). Keep the same honey wood desktops, gray storage pedestals, flat monitors, colorful chair backs. Fit the same four desks together in a shallow 2:1 isometric grid, with room for head-top stat bubbles (draw no bubbles). Desk bases and floor grid should follow a 2:1 diamond, slope±.5, without changing the overall scene's visual personality.
B. Add a modest separate boss desk at the left side of the office and a small gray-haired glasses-wearing boss, facing viewer, navy suit, SAME cute paper-puppet proportions and softly textured style as the existing workers. Paper documents and small dark phone only. Add a modest ivory/honey-wood reception counter nearer the entrance and a brown-haired ponytailed female secretary in muted burgundy, facing viewer, SAME character style. Exactly six people total. Remove the sofa and its coffee table to make space if needed. Keep only two indoor potted plants, two bookcases against wall, whiteboard and cooler; avoid new decorative clutter. Retain the red entrance mat. Spread furniture so center aisles remain open. Do not add a new floor or zoom in.
C. Preserve the full TALL phone canvas and the existing top HUD and bottom business status panel positions. Header date and funds remain as Image 1. Keep the same five-row menu overlay ON THE LEFT, EXACT same cream paper panels, muted green selected row and original cut-paper icon style. Menu labels unchanged in order "开发", "职员", "行动", "信息", "系统". If it occludes the boss that is fine, don't move the boss out of his correct left-side area.
D. Bottom tray must now include a visible LEFT dark inset empty-slot button and a visible RIGHT cream paper button labelled "返回", positioned symmetrically near bottom tray top. Keep small centered upward orange triangle lower down. This is menu OPEN, so left empty/right Return per updated UE. Add the missing slim translucent deep-teal drawer handle with cream "›" on the far LEFT scene edge at mid-low height just above the business panel area. All UI uses THE SAME paper materials as the original master, not glossy volumetric icons. No new palette, no redesign.
The result must look like a localized six-seat scene update of THIS EXACT artwork, not a newly generated similarly themed game. No annotations, no title, no watermark.
